body: I gasped for air, my chest tightening as I realized where those footsteps had come from—a pack of wolves on the horizon. My heart pounding, I felt an overwhelming urge to flee but knew it would only draw them closer. With a deep breath, I gathered my resolve. "Stay beside them and keep them steady," I whispered to myself. Then, with the strength of determination, I stepped forward into their path, shielding myself between them and the approaching danger.
